## 15 Machine-Checked Lean 4.35.0 Headline Theorems (Zero Mathlib, Zero Sorry, Strictly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound])
- T1a (ApollonianReciprocity.lean): Descartes Lorentzian form, involutions, Gaussian norm (a+b)(a+c)=a^2+k^2, Brahmagupta-Descartes BQF identity.
- T1b (JacobiReciprocity.lean): Self-contained zero-Mathlib Legendre-Jacobi symbol, Eisenstein (1844) Gauss Quadratic Reciprocity, both supplementary laws (-1/n) and (2/n), multiplicativity, squares=1.
- T1c (ApollonianReciprocity.lean): Zero-GCD-exception parabolic Dehn-twist CRT proof of HKRS (Annals of Math. 2024) global square obstruction on (-3,5,8,8), (-7,17,12,20), (-11,21,24,28) vs unobstructed (-4,8,9,9) sharing mod-24 set {0,8,9,12,17,20}.
- T1d (ApollonianReciprocity.lean): Generalized Octahedral Q(sqrt(-2)) Lorentzian sextuples, 8 face reflections, exact mod-8 locking (2,2,1,0,0,1) & Jacobi obstruction on (-6,10,17,40,24,17) vs strip (0,0,1,2,2,1) sharing mod-24 set {0,1,2,8,9,10,16,17,18}.
- T1e (ApollonianReciprocity.lean): Exact Soddy dimension integrality dichotomy (d-1) | 2 <=> d=2 or d=3, plus 3D integral cluster (-6,13,13,13,18) reflecting to 25=5^2.
- T2a (SandpileTropical.lean): Universal Abelian sandpile toppling commutativity, Discrete Least Action Principle, and Church-Rosser confluence on all finite sinked graphs.
- T2b (SandpileTropical.lean): Exact Matrix-Tree determinants det(L_{Z2,2x2})=192 and det(L_{Z2,3x3})=100,352 via integer Kronecker block-diagonalization, plus explicit legal Dhar identity traces.
- T2c (SandpileTropical.lean): Levine-Pegden-Smart Z^2 torus discrete Green's First Identity, periodic superharmonic rigidity, isotropic max-sea K=3 obstruction, constant Laplacian 2 and 3 witnesses.
- T2d (SandpileTropical.lean, ORIGINAL): Triangular Lattice A_2 (deg=6) Even-Laplacian Rigidity — every periodic integer superharmonic envelope M*u = A*x^2+B*x*y+C*y^2+D*x+E*y+psi with Δ_{A2} u <= K and M*K = 4A-2B+4C satisfies K % 2 = 0, universally obstructing maximal stable height K=5 while certifying K=4 and K=2.
- T2e (SandpileTropical.lean): Kalinin-Shkolnikov universal cyclic lattice polygon balancing sum R_90(v_{i+1}-v_i)=(0,0), trivalent determinant conservation, and 2-/3-soliton scattering conservation.
- T3a (MarkovHurwitzCluster.lean): Universal SL_2(Z) Fricke trace identity and infinite Cohn matrix tree tr/3 correspondence.
- T3b (MarkovHurwitzCluster.lean, ORIGINAL MOD-32): Pairwise coprimality, odd prime obstruction p=1 (mod 4), odd Markov m=1 (mod 4), and Exact Mod-32 Theorem: every even Markov number satisfies m % 32 = 2 (sharp mod 64 at 2 and 34).
- T3c (MarkovHurwitzCluster.lean): Universal Hensel lifting uniqueness of sqrt(-1) mod p^k for every odd prime p and exponent k >= 1.
- T3d (MarkovHurwitzCluster.lean): Symbolic 3-variable Fomin-Zelevinsky cluster-algebra Laurent integrality & positivity through 5 mutations including consecutive non-monomial polynomial divisions by P1 and P2, specializing at (1,1,1) to (2, 5, 29, 433, 37666).
- T3e (MarkovHurwitzCluster.lean): Complete Markov-Hurwitz n=4 classification via well-founded Vieta descent (a=1 all entries = 2 mod 4; a=4 all odd; a in {2,3} and a >= 5 empty).
